title: Poisons the only cures
html_source: The alternative medical system of homeopathy was developed in Germany at the end of the 18th century. Supporters of homeopathy believe “like cures like”—the notion that a disease can be cured by a substance that produces similar symptoms in healthy people. Homeopathic remedies are derived from substances that come from plants, minerals, or animals, such as red onion, arnica (mountain herb), crushed whole bees, white arsenic, poison ivy, belladonna (deadly nightshade), and stinging nettle.
